prior_matrix.identity: Deprez and Frommel, Are simple technical trading rules profitable in bitcoin markets?, International Review of Economics & Finance 93, 2024, DOI 10.1016/j.iref.2024.05.003
prior_matrix.finding: The study evaluates 75,360 technical rules with transaction costs, false-discovery control and out-of-sample portfolios. It defines OBV as cumulative signed volume and applies moving-average rules to OBV. Its complete-sample discussion reports OBV rules as the strongest class, while daily rules were more robust to cost increases than higher-frequency rules.
prior_matrix.parameter_boundary: The paper's published OBV grid includes short length 2, long lengths 18, 24 and 30, zero band, zero delay and an indefinite hold until a different signal. The present experiment freezes primary 2/24 and rejection-only 2/18 and 2/30 neighbors before outcome access. It does not claim that this exact tuple was the paper's selected best rule.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: The paper used Bitstamp BTC-USD data from 2012-2022, rolling rule selection and portfolios. It does not establish profitability for one fixed OKX BTC-USDT rule during 2020-2024, zero-yield cash, this cost model, or independent OOS.

prior_matrix.identity: Anghel, A reality check on trading rule performance in the cryptocurrency market: Machine Learning vs. Technical Analysis, Finance Research Letters 39, 2021, DOI 10.1016/j.frl.2020.101655
prior_matrix.finding: After controlling for data snooping, market frictions and risk, statistically significant positive excess returns were rare; apparent trading-rule performance was often associated with beta, idiosyncratic volatility and market frictions.
prior_matrix.transfer_boundary: This is a cross-cryptocurrency reality check rather than a direct rejection of the frozen OBV tuple. It requires this experiment to pre-register variants, charge fees and slippage, compare matched capital, measure path risk and close the family on weak breadth instead of selecting a winner after outcomes.

executable_data_path_proof.decision_feature: Cumulative signed volume and its two complete-day versus 18, 24 or 30 complete-day simple moving averages, computed only after a complete UTC day and executed at the next hourly open.
executable_data_path_proof.prospective_transport: The existing sealed OKX BTC-USDT H1 source already provides close and base volume; no new source, credential, paid API, timer, writer or backfill is required.

independence_from_closed_families: The closed DRA directional-volume-participation filter used the share of positive-return hourly volume inside one day and retained the DRA parent; this experiment uses cumulative signed complete-day volume, moving-average state and a standalone full-capital long/cash policy.
The open forward volume-confirmation family uses total daily volume relative to its prior twenty-day median as a DRA admission diagnostic; it does not use signed accumulation or an OBV trend state.
The closed intraday-volume-concentration, raw Amihud, close-location and search-attention interactions do not implement cumulative OBV moving-average timing.
The closed price-only time-series-momentum and Donchian families use price direction or price extrema without volume flow; OBV can disagree with price trend when participation diverges.
real_time_design_requirements: Use complete UTC days only and execute a changed target at the next hourly open.
Use primary 2/24 OBV SMA and rejection-only 2/18 and 2/30 neighbors; no tuple may replace a failed primary.
Use no band, delay, minimum hold, leverage, short position, cash yield, price filter, DRA interaction or alternate volume transform.
Compare with full-capital BTC buy-and-hold under the same initial equity, hourly path, fee, adverse slippage and valuation boundary.
Report realized, unrealized and total return, drawdown, underwater duration, Calmar, exposure, turnover, holding age, episode concentration and terminal inventory.

Require positive after-cost returns, meaningful upside capture, lower drawdown with non-worse risk-adjusted performance, annual breadth and neighbor stability; otherwise permanently close the exact family.
uncertainty: The supportive paper's strongest evidence is for dynamically selected portfolios of many rules, not one immutable OBV tuple.
Single-venue base volume can change with market-share migration and may not represent aggregate Bitcoin demand.
OBV levels are path-dependent, although a constant starting offset cancels in same-window moving-average comparisons.
Historical Design and Validation through 2024 cannot establish post-selection OOS value or activation authority.
claim_boundary: This prior authorizes exactly one preregistered historical three-variant OBV moving-average matched-capital screen. It does not establish alpha, a candidate, OOS value, deployability or Trading authority.
